home.title: Loom AI · Connecting Intelligence. Crafting Tomorrow.
home.label: Home
home.description: Connecting intelligence. Crafting tomorrow. Discover the Loom AI vision and explore creative-tool product planning in your workspace.
home.content: Loom AI aims to connect context across desktop, browser, and editor tools so people and intelligence can collaborate. Discover the vision, explore the workspace, and unlock a creative-tool work plan with Loom Pro.

vision.title: Our Vision · Loom AI
vision.label: Our vision
vision.description: Discover how Loom AI aims to connect tools and context, turning scattered discoveries into clear next steps.
vision.content: Our vision is to carry ideas beyond a single window, let context flow across familiar tools, and help people turn thoughts into action together with intelligence. Desktop, browser, and editor experiences are the connections Loom AI is exploring.

workspace.title: Loom Workspace · From Idea to Action
workspace.label: Loom workspace
workspace.description: Explore a creative-tool work plan and find your next step around the goal, the context, and a first release.
workspace.content: Loom Workspace provides a creative-tool work plan curated by Loom. Sign in and unlock Loom Pro to view steps for defining the product goal, organizing context, and delivering a first release. The plan is for reading and planning; it does not call models, create files, or perform external actions.

pricing.title: Plans & Pricing · Loom Explore and Loom Pro
pricing.label: Plans & pricing
pricing.description: Explore Loom AI for free or unlock the Loom Pro work plan with a one-time purchase. The current USD 1.00 payment is a test and makes no real charge.
pricing.content: Loom Explore offers free access to the vision and workspace introduction. Loom Pro unlocks the creative-tool work plan with a one-time purchase and saves access to your account, with no subscription or automatic renewal. The current USD 1.00 payment uses Stripe Sandbox and makes no real charge; it is not a commercial price.
